name: Tujhse Hai Raabta
description: Tale of a bittersweet relationship between stepmother and daughter.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Kalyani decides to get her parents, Madhuri and Atul, remarried on their 18th wedding anniversary. She surprises them by showing her tattoo of their names, and explains that the pain of getting the tattoo done was nowhere close to the pains they took for her upbringing. To make the day more special, she tricks an old lady into buying her champagne as she is underaged. Later, she catches a man trying to run away with the temple’s jewellery. After reaching home, she gets the shock of her life.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Madhuri hangs from the balcony while Atul tries to save her. Madhuri falls from the balcony and is rushed to the hospital. Coincidentally, Atharv is brought to the same hospital. Kalyani requests Atharv to take his curse back. The nurse informs Atul that Madhuri's health is deteriorating. When Kalyani asks Madhuri who was responsible for the accident, she takes Anupriya's name and breathes her last. The police take Atul in custody in spite of Kalyani vouching for his innocence.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Ahilya reaches the hospital to meet Atharv and finds out that Kalyani had filed a complaint against him for theft. Later, at the police station, when Kalyani pleads for Atul's innocence, the inspector informs her that Madhuri had filed a complaint against him for abuse. The inspector interrogates Atul about the accident. When Kalyani checks Atul's phone, she sees a message from Madhuri about Anupriya. The hospital authority denies giving Kalyani the custody of her mother's body.
